records.identity: JOSEPH JOESTAR AGED67 from JOJO PART3 STARDUST CRUSADERS. The supplied OLD local crop incorrectly depicts young Part2 Joseph: DO NOT copy young brown spiky hair, green sleeveless top, yellow scarf or jeans. Correct to sturdy muscular OLDER man, short GRAY hair, well-trimmed GRAY BEARD, BEIGE FEDORA with brown band, light beige short-sleeved plain shirt, khaki trousers/belt, brown dress shoes, WHITE GLOVES with dark wristbands concealing prosthetic left hand. Still energetic adult build, NOT frail Part4 old man. Stand HERMIT PURPLE is actual PURPLE THORN-COVERED VINES emerging from HANDS, no humanoid ghost/guardian/body. HAMON is a small GOLDEN current conducted ALONG purple vines, not an energy gun or huge beam. NO Tommygun, clackers, youngPart2 scarf, swords or cameras as attack weapons.
rows: IDLE: 1 older Joseph with gray beard/fedora in calm alert stance, hands near belt; 2 shifts weight and raises gloved wrist slightly; 3 adjusts fedora brim and checks right; 4 returns guard with tiny short purple thorn vine curl at hand. Four different anatomies, no youngPart2 clothing.

RUN: four consecutive different running stride beats to right, alternating leg extension/passing poses, mature muscular build, beige shirt/khaki pants/whitegloves/fedora steady; no gun/clackers, no giant magic effects or cropping.

ATTACK Liane dHermitPurple: 1 gathers a short PURPLE THORNY VINE at right wrist with elbow bent; 2 extends left gloved palm while right vine coils forward; 3 firm forward lashing/contact gesture with compact visible violet thorn strand toward right, no goldenbeam, no humanoid Stand; 4 pulls vine back into guarded hands and steady footing. Four fresh physical body poses.

HIT: 1 surprised lean backward with hands raised; 2 torso twists and one hand steadies fedora; 3 drops into bent-knee recovery with glove near ground; 4 regains guarded stance with vine curled small at wrist. No blood, no fall onto hat, no young brown-haired face.
